run_autoround_quantize_and_save: run AutoRound RTN quantization on a model and export to mlx or auto_round format
read_quantization_config: read the quantization_config dictionary from an exported model directory
count_mlx_layers: count QuantLinearMLX instances in a loaded HuggingFace model
generate_with_mlx_lm: load a native MLX checkpoint through mlx_lm and generate text
generate_with_hf_transformers: load an auto_round checkpoint through HF transformers and generate text
